# YourDictionary

> > YourDictionary is a comprehensive English language reference platform offering dictionary definitions, thesaurus lookups, grammar guides, and word game solving tools.

YourDictionary provides free access to curated dictionary definitions from authoritative sources like Webster's and American Heritage Dictionary, alongside interactive tools for word discovery and game assistance. The platform serves both language learners and word game enthusiasts with content spanning vocabulary, grammar, usage, and creative writing.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary definitions
- Synonyms and antonyms
- Grammar rules
- Parts of speech
- Word games
- Scrabble
- Wordle
- Words With Friends
- Vocabulary
- Sentence examples
- Word meanings
- Adjectives
- Punctuation
- English language
- WordFinder

## Core Reference Tools

- [Dictionary Definitions](https://www.yourdictionary.com/dictionary-definitions): Main dictionary definitions with Webster's and American Heritage sources
- [Free Thesaurus | Synonyms & Antonyms](https://thesaurus.yourdictionary.com): Thesaurus tool for synonyms and antonyms from Roget's
- [Sentence Examples | Examples of Words Used in a Sentence](https://sentence.yourdictionary.com): Sentence examples showing word usage and context in English

## Word Game Solvers & Helpers

- [Word Finder | Scrabble Cheat & Word Game Helper](https://wordfinder.yourdictionary.com): Word game solver for Scrabble, Words With Friends, and Wordle
- [Wordle Solver & Letter Finder - Get Help on Today's Puzzle](https://wordfinder.yourdictionary.com/wordle): Wordle solver and letter finder for daily puzzle help
- [Words With Friends Cheat and Helper | WordFinder®](https://wordfinder.yourdictionary.com/words-with-friends-cheat): Words With Friends cheat tool and word finder helper
- [Word Unscrambler - Make Words With Letters](https://wordfinder.yourdictionary.com/unscrabble): Word unscrambler for anagrams in Scrabble and word games
- [Anagram Solver - Decode & Find All Solutions | WordFinder®](https://wordfinder.yourdictionary.com/anagram-solver): Anagram solver for word games and puzzle solutions
- [Scrabble Word Checker & Dictionary | Check Playable Words](https://wordfinder.yourdictionary.com/scrabble-dictionary): Scrabble dictionary with word validation and point values
- [Wordscapes Cheat and Answers by WordFinder](https://wordscapes.yourdictionary.com): Wordscapes game cheats, answers, and level guides

## Grammar & Language Learning

- [Grammar | YourDictionary](https://www.yourdictionary.com/articles/grammar): Grammar guide covering parts of speech, verbs, and punctuation
- [Adjectives | YourDictionary](https://www.yourdictionary.com/articles/adjectives): Grammar guide covering adjectives, types, and usage
- [How to Order Adjectives in a Sentence | YourDictionary](https://www.yourdictionary.com/articles/cumulative-adjectives): Grammar guide on adjective ordering and placement in sentences
- [How and When To Use Single Quotation Marks ( ' ' ) | YourDictionary](https://www.yourdictionary.com/articles/single-quotation-marks): Punctuation guide on using single quotation marks correctly

## Vocabulary & Usage Guides

- [Vocabulary | YourDictionary](https://www.yourdictionary.com/articles/vocabulary): Vocabulary guide with etymology, slang history, and word comparisons
- [Usage | YourDictionary](https://www.yourdictionary.com/articles/usage): Usage guide for word meanings, pronunciation, and cultural terms
- [Reading & Writing | YourDictionary](https://www.yourdictionary.com/articles/reading-writing): Writing guide with prompts, literary devices, and creative writing tips
